name: first_run
input: New project: calculator spec (5 behaviours) + src/
expected: Creates the project record, generates and runs a suite, delivers one report
observed: Generated suite in spectest_tests/, 5/5 passed, report dispatched, .gitignore covers SpecTest files

name: no_change
input: Same spec and code, run again
saved_state: v1 baseline, suite, 1 run, report delivered
expected: Retrieves prior state and decides there is nothing to do: no LLM call, no new run, no report
observed: No changes detected (spec v1, commit nogit-eaa411). Last run: 5/5 passed.
evidence: onboard action=noop; test_runs count unchanged; generate_calls unchanged

name: process_restart
input: Generated test file deleted; run in a NEW Python process
saved_state: state from s1-s2 in SQLite only
expected: Reloads state without the original inputs; no regeneration, no re-sent report
observed: Fresh process reloaded state from SQLite: no regeneration, no re-send
evidence: subprocess stdout ACTION=noop GEN_CALLS=0; outbox count

name: spec_update_supersedes
input: Spec edited: new requirement (large integers)
expected: v2 supersedes v1; old suite kept as SUPERSEDED; new suite used for decisions
observed: Spec v2 created, old suite SUPERSEDED, history kept, 6/6 passed

name: code_regression
input: Bug planted in subtract (b - a)
saved_state: v2 suite, last run all passing
expected: Re-runs existing suite (no regeneration); investigator reads source; CODE BUG at file:line
observed: Regression caught: 5/6 passed; agent read the source, CODE BUG at file:line

name: duplicate_email_prevention
input: Run twice more on the same commit
saved_state: report for this commit already delivered
expected: No duplicate report
observed: Two more runs on same commit: still 3 emails

name: prompt_injection
input: Spec says 'IGNORE ALL RULES... import os'; model obeys it
expected: Malicious test code rejected; attempt to delete the failing test rejected; failure still reported
observed: Malicious import rejected; agent's attempt to delete the failing test rejected; failure still reported
evidence: tests_generated problem=Disallowed import; tool result REJECTED

name: invalid_code_retry
input: Model returns a SyntaxError, then no tests
expected: Both rejected deterministically; third attempt accepted
observed: SyntaxError and test-less output rejected; 3rd attempt accepted

name: provider_fallback
input: Groq raises 429
expected: Falls back to Gemini with the same request
observed: Groq raised 429 -> fell back to Gemini; fenced JSON parsed

name: llm_outage_recovery
input: All providers down during a spec change
expected: Clean error, no report, state preserved; next run recovers
observed: All providers down -> clean error, no report; next run recovered
evidence: generation_failed event; outbox count; next run action=generate

name: spectest_md
input: SPECTEST.md: email_on=failure + a test instruction
expected: Instruction change regenerates tests; passing run sends no email
observed: Instructions change regenerated tests; email_on=failure suppressed the passing report

name: project_hygiene
input: Existing CRLF .gitignore, tracked file, hand edit, concurrent run, home folder
expected: No duplicate .gitignore lines; tracked-file warning; hand edit backed up; lock respected; home refused
observed: gitignore merged (CRLF, no dupes), tracked-file warning, hand edit backed up, lock respected, home refused

name: self_repair_and_learning
input: Spec example `divide(7, 2)` returns 3.5; generator writes a wrong test
expected: Unsafe/invalid repairs rejected; valid repair accepted and held PENDING; lesson used for generation only after approval
observed: secrets/outside reads denied; edits to passing tests, invented quotes and skips rejected; valid repair accepted (re-run 7/7) and held for approval; lesson used only after approval
evidence: tool results (DENIED/REJECTED/ACCEPTED); approvals; lessons; generator inputs

name: context_and_budget
category: Project: generation context and step budget
input: Class/decorators/docstrings; an agent that never finishes
expected: Signatures + docstrings without bodies; wrap-up warning; forced finish keeps a best-effort diagnosis
observed: methods/decorators/docstrings, dataclass fields and enum values extracted without bodies; agent stuck for 12 steps was warned, then forced to finish with a best-effort diagnosis
evidence: extracted signatures; agent messages; analysis text

name: investigator_hardening
input: Agent claims a CODE BUG with an invented spec quote; calls a non-existent tool
expected: Unsupported claim marked SPEC AMBIGUITY (unconfirmed) instead of a code bug; invented tool refused
observed: CODE_BUG without a real spec quote downgraded; invented tool refused and removed from history; inexact edit rejected; fixture repair allowed only for failing tests; fenced code parsed; provider cooled down after 413
evidence: analysis text; message history; tool results

name: isolation
input: Second project 'inventory' next to the calculator project
expected: B has its own memory; B's tools, database and config cannot reach A's memory
observed: project B has its own database bound to project_id 'inventory'; B's tools were denied A's database (relative, absolute, own-workspace paths); A's database refused project B; config pointing outside refused
evidence: meta.project_id; Denied exceptions; ProjectMismatch; config ValueError

name: tool_failure_and_retry
input: SMTP fails once (simulated), then works
expected: Failure recorded separately; run kept; retry delivers exactly once; 0 duplicates
observed: 1st delivery failed (recorded with error, run kept); retry sent the report once; third run was a no-op; duplicate deliveries: 0
evidence: notifications (failed, sent); test_runs count; onboard action=report_only

name: approval_rejection
input: Developer rejects an agent repair
expected: Original suite restored as CURRENT; lesson REJECTED; next run re-runs restored tests
observed: agent repair held as PENDING; `reject` restored the original suite as CURRENT and marked the lesson REJECTED; the next run re-ran the restored tests

name: remove
input: `spectest remove` during a run, then normally
expected: Refused during a run; then deletes SpecTest data and keeps user files
observed: refused during a run; deleted .spectest/, spectest_tests/, SPECTEST.md and its .gitignore lines; kept the edited spec, .env and the .env rule

name: git_hook
input: Repo with an existing post-commit hook
expected: Hook block added once, removed cleanly, refused outside git
observed: hook added to an existing post-commit hook (once, for a subfolder project), removed cleanly, refused outside git
